summary: Full backend + frontend testing of FootPulse Analytics (French football stats app). Created pytest suite covering all 11 API endpoints (13 tests, 100% pass). Frontend E2E tested via Playwright: home matches grid, date/league filters, match detail with signals + estimated goals + player unavailable, transparent ScoreBreakdown modal, leaderboards (teams sorted + players unavailable), team page with historical evolution chart, search, methodology page, and mobile viewport. All flows work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py paris_date() called with empty timezone suffix concatenation `+ ''` in /api/matches — works but unnecessary; datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() already includes offset.
/api/leaderboard/teams (all leagues) iterates all 7 competitions synchronously with per-team analyze — can be slow (took ~2s in tests, acceptable but could be cached).
Breakdown 'contribution' values are individually rounded then summed; tolerance up to 2 pts vs displayed score. Verified within acceptable ±3.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 2364 synced matches. Test match_id: 558894 (Excelsior vs Utrecht).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers status, competitions, dates, matches (today + with date+code), match detail (breakdown sum validation + signals shape + joueurs.disponible=false + 404), leaderboards (sorted, players unavailable), team detail, search, scoring/config. All pass. Frontend confirmed: match card data-testid=match-card-{id}, league-filter-{code}, date-prev/next/picker, score badges & 'voir le détail' bars open ScoreBreakdown modal correctly, /classements has Équipes/Joueurs tabs, /equipe/:code/:id shows évolution chart, /recherche works, /methodologie shows coefficients. Mobile viewport 390x844 renders correctly. Date at test time: 2026-09-13.
